purpose: Eureka! time-series reduction of JWST raw exposures (stages 1-4), on the STScI jwst pipeline, for eclipse mapping from raw data.

patches.reason: Eureka! 1.4 turns a scalar gain from the control file into DataArray(gain, dims=('y','x')), which raises 'different number of dimensions on data and dims: 0 vs 2' for MIRI.
patches.find:
# Convert to electrons
    gain = xr.DataArray(gain, dims=("y", "x"))
patches.replace:
# Convert to electrons
    if np.ndim(gain) == 0:
        # A constant gain from the ECF applies to every pixel of the window.
        gain = np.full(data['flux'].shape[1:], float(gain))
    gain = xr.DataArray(gain, dims=("y", "x"))

memory: Stage 1 of one MIRI SLITLESSPRISM segment (309 integrations x 64 groups) peaks at 14.5-17 GB with one worker; never run two.
